title: Repository policy Apply idempotency and authority binding

phases.objective: Bind repository-policy Apply plan identity and caller idempotency to the exact authority snapshot, while rejecting malformed or incomplete authority before persistence, provider readback, or mutation dispatch.

e2e_journeys.actor: authenticated platform Admin through repository automation
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Repository policy Apply through the operational repositoryAutomationPolicyFacade boundary.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Apply identity changes when main SHA, policy fingerprint, capability envelope, typed confirmation, or caller retry identity changes; malformed authority fails before readback or provider access, while valid dry-run and mocked Apply behavior remain compatible.
steps: Build an Apply plan using exact main SHA, exact policy fingerprint, typed confirmation, and capability-envelope identity.
Hash the authority inputs into a secret-free Apply binding and include it in plan identity.
Bind any caller-supplied idempotency key to the resulting plan SHA instead of accepting the caller key as the persisted identity directly.
Reject non-Admin Apply before returning authority-validation details.
Reject overlong SHA, fingerprint, missing envelope, overlong envelope, or invalid typed confirmation before persistence or provider readback.
Execute the focused facade regression to prove zero provider calls for invalid authority and compatibility for valid dry-run and mocked Apply.
assertions: Different capability envelopes produce different plan identities without exposing the raw envelope ID.
Different expected main SHAs produce different plan identities.
The same caller retry key cannot collide across different authority-bound plans.
Expected main SHA is exactly 40 hexadecimal characters and expected policy fingerprint is exactly 64 hexadecimal characters for Apply.
Capability envelope identity is required, bounded to at most 64 characters, and rejected before readback when missing or overlong.
Non-Admin callers fail before authority-validation detail is disclosed.
Malformed Apply authority produces zero persistence/readback/provider calls in the focused regression.
No raw capability-envelope identity, provider credential, secret, token, protected-ref mutation, deployment, database action, migration apply, external send, or force push is introduced.

phases.objective: Preserve the same authority-bound idempotency identity in persisted operational evidence after separately authorized live repository-policy execution becomes available.
Prove retry and ambiguity recovery cannot reuse an Apply run across changed authority snapshots or capability envelopes.
This idempotency and authority-boundary correction has no Tenant, provider, or runtime canary authority.
This helper grants no Production, deployment, live repository-policy apply, migration apply, database, credential, provider, protected-ref, or external-send authority.
